name: Amylocaine
summary: Amylocaine was the first synthetic local anesthetic. It was synthesized and patented under the name Stovaine by Ernest Fourneau at the Pasteur Institute in 1903. It was used mostly in spinal anesthesia.

uses.text: Amylocaine was the first synthetic local anesthetic. It was used mostly in spinal anesthesia.

pharmacology.en: Like other local anaesthetics, it blocks the sodium channels that nerve cells use to fire. With those channels shut, the nerve cannot pass a pain signal along, so the area goes numb.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他局部麻醉劑一樣，它阻斷神經細胞放電所用的鈉離子通道。通道關閉後，神經無法傳遞疼痛訊號，該區域便失去感覺。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他局部麻醉剂一样，它阻断神经细胞放电所用的钠离子信道。信道关闭后，神经无法传递疼痛信号，该区域便失去感觉。

sideEffects.en: It was more irritating to tissue than later anaesthetics and was linked to nerve damage after spinal injection, which is why it was replaced. Local anaesthetics reaching the bloodstream can cause ringing in the ears, seizures and heart rhythm problems.
sideEffects.zh: 它對組織的刺激性比後來的麻醉劑強，脊椎注射後曾與神經損傷有關，因此被取代。局部麻醉劑進入血流可能造成耳鳴、癲癇發作與心律問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对组织的刺激性比后来的麻醉剂强，脊椎注射后曾与神经损伤有关，因此被取代。局部麻醉剂进入血流可能造成耳鸣、癫痫发作与心律问题。

fact.en: Amylocaine was the first synthetic local anaesthetic, made in 1903 by Ernest Fourneau at the Pasteur Institute. He named it Stovaine as a pun: fourneau means stove in French.
fact.zh: Amylocaine 是第一個合成的局部麻醉劑，由 Ernest Fourneau 於 1903 年在巴斯德研究所合成。他把它命名為 Stovaine，是個雙關語：fourneau 在法文中意為火爐。
fact.zhHans: Amylocaine 是第一个合成的局部麻醉剂，由 Ernest Fourneau 于 1903 年在巴斯德研究所合成。他把它命名为 Stovaine，是个双关语：fourneau 在法文中意为火炉。
